static_traits.name: Chen Xinya
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young sibling
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues due to insufficient confidence; unwilling to tell family about work troubles
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy before; no similar problems of equal intensity before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe automatic thoughts and bodily reactions concretely; highly cooperative; tense tone, prone to self-denial

basic_info.main_problem: Low self-evaluation at work, feeling incompetent with low sense of self-worth, strongly triggered especially when making mistakes (such as messing up a customer order); after a major work mistake a few months ago drew negative feedback from the manager, overall confidence and work performance declined, with increased anxiety and self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to be more confident at work, no longer harshly negating oneself for mistakes, stopping feeling like a failure; because self-esteem issues have affected work performance and overall physical and mental health.

core_beliefs: Making mistakes equals I have no value

special_situations.event: Getting customer orders wrong at the grocery store job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake at work, it means I am incompetent and may be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becomes more careful and cautious; seeks colleagues' comfort and reassurance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a useless employee, the manager will blame me / I may lose my job

special_situations.event: Received negative feedback from the manager after that major mistake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If criticized, it means my overall ability is very poor and everyone will think I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Extra careful at work to avoid making mistakes again, while seeking confirmation from colleagues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed the manager, it is all my fault

special_situations.event: When facing challenging tasks at work or complex interactions with customers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as a task is challenging, I am very likely to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Slows down and operates more carefully to avoid making mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am sure I will mess up / make mistakes again

special_situations.event: Small mistakes occurring but the customer understanding, the manager not yet noticing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even if the outcome is not bad, it does not mean I am not incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive evidence, keeps measuring oneself by negative standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This does not count, I am still terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen as a competent and valuable employee
core_conflict.fear: Fearing criticism, being negated, even losing the job
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being criticized and maintains a sense of safety through excessive caution and seeking others' reassurance

object_relations.object_representation: A harsh, picky judge who may negate oneself at any time (such as the manager)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a 'behavioral experiment', needing to deliberately make a controllable small mistake at work to test the catastrophic belief
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client understands the suggestion as exposing themselves to high risk and criticism, worrying that once a mistake is made it will trigger serious consequences
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopting a supportive, empathic and steady tone; first normalizing her worries, then jointly breaking the experiment into low-risk small steps; using open-ended questions to guide identifying safety boundaries and alternatives, and emphasizing self-care and review during the process.

manifestations: Having a supportive family, but choosing not to reveal work troubles to family so as not to 'add burden'
outcomes: Bearing emotional stress alone, anxiety and self-doubt worsening; increased sense of interpersonal alienation

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Not expressing work anxiety and troubles to family, choosing to digest them alone to avoid 'troubling others'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequent self-denial in session and work situations (such as 'I am a useless employee'), overly cautious, worrying about worst outcomes

exception_events.target_problem: When making mistakes at work, the client usually catastrophically worries about being blamed by the manager or fired, with high anxiety and self-denial, affecting work performance
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once when settling a customer's order incorrectly, the customer was understanding, the manager did not yet notice, and the severe consequences she anticipated did not occur
exception_events.reason: Different situation: the customer was tolerant; different understanding: afterwards reflecting that 'things were not as bad as I thought', realizing she had exaggerated the consequences

positive_force: Willing to try new methods (agrees to carry out behavioral experiments)
Having self-awareness and reflection ability (able to identify automatic thoughts and bodily reactions)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking frequently activated
Self-worth highly depends on work performance and whether one makes mistakes
Sleep and appetite affected, further weakening coping resources
Insufficient confidence and self-denial leading to tense relationships with colleagues, needing external reassurance but hard to relieve

target_behavior.behavior: Strong anxiety with self-denial speech (such as 'I am useless') when making mistakes at work or facing challenging tasks
antecedent: An error occurs at work (e.g. messing up a customer's order)
Receiving negative feedback from the manager
Facing complex customer interactions or challenging tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Equating mistakes with overall incompetence and loss of worth, and worrying about worst outcomes (such as being fired)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome consequences (criticism/firing), seeking control and others' reassurance through self-blame and caution
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, tense relationships with colleagues; sleep and appetite affected, hard to focus on other enjoyed activities
